# Requirement

Show requirements and how they relate to each other and to the elements that satisfy them.

=== "Diagram"

    ```mermaid
    ---
    config:
      theme: default
      look: classic
      layout: dagre
    ---
    requirementDiagram
      requirement checkout_req {
        id: 1
        text: Orders must be payable online.
        risk: high
        verifymethod: test
      }
      functionalRequirement payment_req {
        id: 1.1
        text: Card payments must be authorized.
        risk: high
        verifymethod: test
      }
      element checkout_service {
        type: service
      }
      checkout_req - contains -> payment_req
      checkout_service - satisfies -> payment_req
    ```
